messages:
rachel: Follow-up from the pinning RFC: proposal to implement per-tenant soft-reserve credits (short-lived VRAM holds) + a reclaim waterfall so we can avoid thrashing during spikes. Sketch below, want quick sanity checks.

tom: curious about fairness. soft-reserve sounds risky if one tenant bursts. How do we stop noisy tenants from starving others?

sanjay: token-bucket per-tenant is the straightforward control. rate = credits/sec, burst = banked credits. On allocation we debit credits proportional to page_weight. If bucket empty, allocation gets soft-tag but lower reclaim priority.

rachel: agree. for page_weight we can do: weight = ceil(size_kb / 64) * (1 + short_seq_factor). keeps math cheap.

tom: can we special-case tiny allocations (<64KB) to never consume credits? They cause a lot of churn but are cheap to evict.

sanjay: yes — add a micro-reserve window: micro_pin TTL=50ms, free for allocations <=64KB. long_pin TTL defaults to 5s and consumes credits.

kelsey: API shape? clients want a simple flag. Maybe: alloc(size, pin_hint={kind: MICRO|LONG, ttl_ms:0|n, priority:0-255}). Default = NONE.
rachel: prefer typed struct so we can extend later. Also need an allocator return value that indicates "soft_pinned_until" for telemetry.

sanjay: metadata placement: don't piggyback per-page header. use a sidecar hashmap keyed by page_id -> {tenant, pin_kind, expiry, priority}. Implement as striped lock-free table to keep lookup cheap.
tom: sidecar ok, but compactor/evictor must scan efficiently. Add a bitset on the slab stripe that marks soft-pinned candidates. That avoids hashing entire address space during compaction.
kelsey: reclaim waterfall semantics: step1: demote LONG->MICRO (reduce priority, shorten TTL). step2: mark for async spill if spill enabled. step3: synchronous eviction on critical pressure. Each step emits events for telemetry.
rachel: important: avoid oscillation. add a penalty cooldown per-tenant after a demotion event (e.g., 2x TTL) before they can regain full credits.
sanjay: billing/metrics: ensure soft-reserved tokens do not double-count for customer billing when we prevent async spill. Emit metrics for reserved_kb, demote_count, evict_count so finance can reconcile.
tom: tests: we need a microbench harness that replays realistic burst traces and measures p99 latency, evict rate, and CPU overhead of sidecar lookups.
kelsey: rollout: 1) implement API + sidecar + dry-run telemetry that logs demotion decisions but doesn't enforce, 2) canary on internal tenants, 3) enable opt-in customers via feature flag, 4) wide rollout with operator configs.
offload-bot: deploy-check: canary=runtime-softpin-alpha, rollout=5%, monitors=[pin_credit_usage, demote_rate, evict_rate, p99_gen_latency, spill_io], rollback_on=demote_rate>5% or p99 up 20%.
rachel: open questions: how to weight model affinity (embedding vs decode); how to surface tenant profiles in Console (per-tenant defaults).
sanjay: model-affinity: assign tenant_profile.boost in config and multiply credit budget by (1+boost). Simple and operator controlled.
tom: also need to define semantics for dedicated/dedicated-private clusters: default soft-reserve=disabled for Dedicated unless tenant opts in.
kelsey: I'll write the config schema and telemetry spec. rachel/sanjay -> allocator PR + sidecar impl. we should add a small YAML example for ops.
rachel: thanks — tagging @sanjay @kelsey @tom. please post PR links here when ready. :eyes:
